from hashlib import sha256
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
import json
import re

source_url = 'https://help.payhip.com/'
source = Path('products/services/existing-package-marketplace-checkout/raw/payhip-help-index.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
assert sha256(raw).hexdigest() == 'fefd85c287cddb442b518651816f527d1a242a35ffc8f226cebe3fbac2d7ebae'

class LinkReader(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.href = None
        self.label_parts = []
        self.links = {}

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.label_parts = []

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.href:
            self.label_parts.append(data)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or not self.href:
            return
        url = urljoin(source_url, self.href)
        label = ' '.join(''.join(self.label_parts).split())
        if urlsplit(url).hostname in {'help.payhip.com', 'payhip.com', 'www.payhip.com'} and re.search(r'pricing|fees?|refund|stripe|paypal|payment|payout|seller|terms|prohibited', urlsplit(url).path + ' ' + label, re.I):
            self.links[url] = label or self.links.get(url, '')
        self.href = None

reader = LinkReader()
reader.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
result = {'source': source_url, 'source_sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'scope': 'Links present in the captured index. Linked terms have yet to be retrieved or verified.', 'links': [{'url': url, 'label': label} for url, label in sorted(reader.links.items())]}
output = source.parent.parent / 'payhip-help-seller-links.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
